objective: Rewrite the modular Markdown sources as one continuous instructor course instead of a stack of cards and repeated case templates.

confirmedDecisions.answer: Keep the established progression from reasoning and Prompt through Agent plus Skills, Loop, product architecture, engineering and business cases.
confirmedDecisions.basis: The user repeatedly confirmed the progression and asked for a unified knowledge base rather than a day-based schedule.

confirmedDecisions.answer: Keep modular canonical sources and deterministically compose the complete instructor handbook.
confirmedDecisions.basis: The prior approved Markdown refactor froze this model; the current problem is narrative fragmentation, not the existence of source modules.

confirmedDecisions.answer: Group the 24 cases into four readable acts and replace the seven repeated headings with three case-specific narrative sections.
confirmedDecisions.basis: Half of the current headings come from the same seven labels repeated in every case.

confirmedDecisions.answer: Use concrete roles, objects, numbers and actions; remove internal delivery prose, ritual disclaimers and formulaic contrast sentences from the visible course.
confirmedDecisions.basis: The user explicitly asked for maximum removal of AI-like writing while preserving rigor and teachability.
The rewrite can be verified in bounded editorial iterations and has no release, hardware or regulated stage gate.

targetReadingPath: Start from one concrete product decision and establish the difference between observation, inference and action.
Use Prompt experiments to make one response checkable.
Use Agent and Skills to complete files, data analysis and visible artifacts.
Use Grill, Harness and Loop to manage ambiguity, tools, correction and stopping.
Turn the workflow into roles, states, data contracts and a maintainable system.
Apply the same reasoning in 24 grouped business cases and one course project.

acceptance: The composed course reads in one prerequisite order and contains short transitions between major parts.
The 24 cases remain complete, runnable and individually recognizable, but none uses the old seven-heading template.
Each case keeps its dataset facts, CodeBuddy prompt, runtime screenshot, requirement diagram, architecture diagram, runnable path and troubleshooting guidance.
The complete handbook has no more than 230 level-one through level-three headings and no generic case heading repeated across all cases.
Visible prose contains none of the retired instructor, workshop, evidence-boundary, failure-branch, replay, request-id or hash narration.
Prompt and Agent plus Skills remain practical instructor material rather than command-line runbooks or page-interaction exercises.
Composition, content, links, datasets and course verification pass.
nonGoals: changing the 24 case identifiers or routes
